edge_explainer: The shelf flagged 'net debt 40% of cap' struck on the 30-Nov-2025 unaudited interim - the seasonal peak of a May-year-end housebuilder's working-capital build. Springfield announced on 4 June 2026, two months BEFORE the shelf was generated, that it had eliminated bank debt and holds ~GBP 1m net bank cash, 'significantly ahead of market expectations of year-end net bank debt of GBP 10m', down from a GBP 93.4m peak in Nov-2023. The flag was stale by two reporting events. But the company's own headline understates too: note 31 shows leases (~GBP 5.5m) and Mactaggart & Mickel deferred consideration (~GBP 14.5m after a year of minimum GBP 7.7m payments) on top, so honest net obligations are ~GBP 19m / ~16% of cap. Screen overstates 2.5x, company understates by ~GBP 20m. Offsetting the good news: the 26.7% FCF yield that put it on the shelf is the 17-Feb-2025 sale of 2,500 plots to Barratt Redrow for GBP 64m - the same single transaction produced the GBP 20.4m inventory draw, the FY25 gross-margin uplift to 18.6%, AND the cash that repaid the debt, counted three times, paid for by shrinking the land bank. FY26 revenue is guided to ~GBP 245m, down 12.7%, and H1 FY26 gross profit FELL on 2% higher revenue.

guard_grade: THE COHORT'S COSTLY-WRONG. ncash_r (-0.398) is WRONG - struck on an unaudited interim at the seasonal peak when a public RNS two months older than the shelf reported the debt eliminated. Root cause is the schema gap: the shelf carries no fiscal_year_end and no annual-vs-interim flag, and 40% of the shelf (18 of a 45-name random sample) is struck on an interim balance sheet. SECOND ERROR IN THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION: the 26.7% FCF yield is unpoliced because wc_fcf requires EBIT<0, so it structurally cannot fire on a profitable inventory unwind - 63 of 249 shelf names are profitable with FCF > 1.2x EBIT and are invisible to it. THIRD: provision_kind_hint applies an England-specific Building Safety Act assumption to a Scottish builder that has no such provision. The leverage error and the earnings-quality error point in opposite directions and roughly cancel - that is NOT 'the screen was roughly right', it means neither input was trustworthy and the net was luck.
